symptom: A page data source following a view entity's association from the entity it points at — `listview (DataSource: DATABASE FROM $currentObject/M.Stats_Owner/M.Stats)` on a page over M.Owner, where M.Stats selects `o.ID as Stats_Owner` — passed check --references and exec, then mx check failed CE8812 "Entity 'M.Owner' has no association 'M.Stats_Owner'" (mendixlabs/mxcli#1611 A). Separately, its remedy `DATABASE M.Stats WHERE [M.Stats_Owner = $currentObject]` (and the microflow `retrieve … where M.Stats_Owner = $x`) was refused by check as naming 'neither an attribute nor an association' when the view entity came from the same script.
cause: Nothing modelled that a view entity's OQL-derived association (OqlViewAssociationSource) is one-way for a page; MDL-ASSOCDS01's association index had no view flag. And scriptContext recorded only CREATE ASSOCIATION statements, so a script's view associations (its `<alias>.ID as <Name>` columns) were invisible to every name-resolving checker.
fix: MDL-ASSOCDS02 (validate_view_assoc_reverse.go), hooked into attributeScopeValidator.walk beside MDL-ASSOCDS01: follow the association or `database from` path hop by hop from the widget's context entity and report the first hop that follows a view association from its TO end, with the constrained query as the fix. assocShape.view from Association/CrossAssociation Source == OqlViewAssociationSource; scriptContext.recordViewAssociations registers each view association column through recordAssociation (ends, name index, shape) and marks it view.
insight: Measure the remedy you are about to recommend in the same shape the user works in: the constrained query built at 0 errors against a stored view entity, but the check refused it when the view was created in the same script — the reporter's flow — so the new hint would have sent users into a second false refusal. Measured on 11.14.0, one page per shape with uniquely named widgets so mx check's 'at <widget>' attributes each CE8812: refused in list view, data grid, gallery and data view, database and in-memory form, at any hop; accepted from the view side, constrained, and in a microflow association retrieve (so the rule is page data sources only). An entity named Owner is itself CE7247 — rename repro entities before reading the result.
